lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters are visible on the lateral flank posterior to the gill slits, with an increased density of smaller, less-ordered clusters in the anterior region near the head.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary high-luminance circular clusters, forming a semi-regular grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high-luminance upper surfaces to shadowed lower margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or irregular indentation is present on the posterior trailing margin of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-contrast silhouettes of commensal fish (remoras) are visible in the ventral region, with one attached near the pectoral fin base.
